'''Sorolis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was part of the team defending [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] on the [[Foundry (space station)|''Foundry'']] space station. He was killed by an Imperial strike team during the [[Battle of the Foundry]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Sorolis appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Foundry" flashpoint.
